import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime format
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Aggregate data to find total sales by age group and product
sales_by_age_product = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'product'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sales_by_age_product.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=plt.gca())

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group and Product')
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime format
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Aggregate data to find total sales by age group and product
sales_by_age_product = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'product'])['total'].sum().unstack()

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sales_by_age_product.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=plt.gca())

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Total Sales by Customer Age Group and Product')
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
